jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Game Artist (Generalist)

We are looking for a versatile Game Artist to join our team and help bring our game worlds, characters, props, and visual systems to life. This role is ideal for an artist who is comfortable moving between 2D and 3D workflows, can take rough ideas from concept to polished in-game assets, and enjoys collaborating closely with designers and developers in a small, fast-moving team environment.

As a Game Artist, you will contribute across the full art pipeline, from visual development and asset creation to engine integration, lighting, materials, VFX, and final polish. You should be comfortable solving visual problems independently, iterating quickly, and ensuring that your work supports both the artistic direction and gameplay experience.

Responsibilities

• Translate rough concepts, references, and design ideas into finalized 2D and 3D game assets, including environments, characters, props, and supporting visual elements.
• Model, texture, and optimize high- and low-poly assets for use in real-time game engines.
• Create textures, materials, and shaders that support the game’s visual style and technical requirements.
• Import, organize, and set up assets, scenes, cameras, lighting, and materials in engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
• Create visual polish elements, including particle effects, simple animations, material effects, and other VFX that improve gameplay clarity and presentation.
• Collaborate with designers, engineers, animators, and other team members to ensure art assets support gameplay mechanics, readability, and performance budgets.
• Iterate on assets based on feedback from stakeholders, playtests, and technical constraints.
• Maintain clean, organized source files and follow established naming, versioning, and implementation standards.
• Help define and maintain a consistent visual style across multiple asset types and game systems.

Qualifications

• Broad generalist skillset across modeling, texturing, lighting, materials, and basic rigging or animation.
• Strong proficiency with industry-standard art tools such as Photoshop and DCC software including Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, or equivalent tools.
• Experience working with real-time game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
• Strong understanding of color theory, composition, lighting, form, silhouette, and visual readability.
• Ability to create assets across a range of styles, from stylized to realistic, depending on project needs.
• Portfolio demonstrating strong artistic fundamentals and a variety of completed 2D and/or 3D game art work.
• Ability to work independently, solve visual and technical problems, and make progress with minimal oversight.
• Strong communication skills and comfort working closely with design and engineering disciplines.
• Understanding of optimization, asset budgets, and performance considerations for real-time games.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience creating VFX, particle systems, shaders, or procedural materials.
• Familiarity with character art workflows, including rigging, skinning, or simple animation.
• Experience with environment art, set dressing, lighting, and scene composition.
• Understanding of version control tools and collaborative game development workflows.
• Experience working on small teams, prototypes, indie games, or live production environments.
• Basic scripting or blueprint/visual scripting knowledge in Unity or Unreal Engine.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is adaptable, self-directed, and excited to contribute wherever art support is needed. The ideal candidate is not limited to one narrow specialty; they are comfortable jumping between asset types, tools, and workflows to help the team move quickly while maintaining a high visual quality bar.

You should be able to take an idea from rough direction to an implemented, polished in-game result, while balancing creativity, performance, and gameplay clarity.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.

$109,600—$164,400 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

Property Adjuster Specialist focus on using technology and desk adjusting for a virtual first approach to inspections and claims handling. Determines coverage through analyzing information involving complex policy terms and contingencies. Determines and negotiates complex claims settlement within authority limits. 회사 소개

CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.

쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.

CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.

직무 소개

Automation Maintenance 팀은 물류센터 내에 구축된 다양한 자동화 설비를 직접 운영·관리하며 안정적인 센터 운영을 지원하는 조직입니다. 상품 분류 설비인 소터(Sorter), 무인 이동 로봇인 자동 유도 차량(Automated Guided Vehicle)과 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot), 자동 라벨링 및 패키징 설비, 로봇 암, 컨베이어 등 핵심 자동화 장비의 유지보수와 성능 관리를 담당합니다. 또한 신규 자동화 설비 도입과 지속적인 개선 활동을 통해 현장 근로자의 작업 효율을 높이고 생산성을 극대화합니다. 이를 통해 물류 운영의 안정성과 품질을 강화하며, 쿠팡의 핵심 가치인 고객 만족 실현에 기여합니다.

• 물류센터 내 자동화 설비의 유지보수 및 예방보전 활동 수행

• - 설비 예시: 컨베이어, 자동 분류기(오토소터), 자동 저장 시스템(OSR) 등

• - 예시: MTBF(고장 간 평균 시간), MTTR(평균 수리 시간) 등

• 설비 보전 경험 보유자

우대 사항

jobs.description: Do you want to work on the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure? Then we have the perfect job for you! Mid 2013, our Amazon Web Services S3 web service accepted its 2 trillionth object and that the service is regularly peaking at over 1.1 million requests per second. To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in every region. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! We are currently looking for an experienced, detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports our Data Center Organization within Amazon. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers. The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. This is data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities. Amazon offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining our computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner. Responsibilities: - You will assist in the operation, and maintenance of all electrical,mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. - You will assist in maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support. - You will monitor and troubleshoot of all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems,voice/data, chiller systems and generators. - You will provide assistance to contractor or data center engineer to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment covered under level I plus areas in which they are certified such as making and running fiber optic, electrical certification, HVAC repair (training/certification), UPS and or generator certifications and training. - You will provide assistance to contractor or data center engineer to deploy new equipment, such as, building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary. - You will responds to internal Rack customer maintenance, repair and additions/expansion requests through the ticketing system, - You will perform site walkthroughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems. - You will maintain changes in state in Mission Critical infrastructure in support of corrective/ preventive maintenance. - You will review the Test quality, performance, safety, and reliability of products, equipment, processes. Key job responsibilities AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
